claim_boundary: This preregistration freezes one offline spherical free-atom Hartree-Fock independent-particle response construction. It reads no target-solvation labels and is not a molecular response functional, continuum calculation, force/PES result, solvation calculation, performance result, or accuracy result. A pass freezes only a neutral positive baseline C0 for the separately preregistered V0-RK acetone gas-phase MEP falsifier.

generation_contract.method: PySCF AtomSphAverageRHF canonical-orbital independent-particle static response
generation_contract.transition_rule: Sort canonical spatial orbitals by ascending energy with a stable sort. For every pair i< a with n_i-n_a > numerical_relative_tolerance and epsilon_a-epsilon_i > numerical_relative_tolerance*max(1, ||epsilon||_2), retain tau_ia(r)=phi_i(r)phi_a(r)+phi_a(r)phi_i(r) with w_ia=(n_i-n_a)/(2*(epsilon_a-epsilon_i)). Retain every such pair; do not screen a transition by QM-MEP, continuum, or solvation error.

decision_rule: A failed atomic SCF, canonical-orbital orthonormality, transition neutrality, positive atomic dipole covariance, isotropy, source hash, runtime, deterministic archive, manifest hash, or repeated table hash rejects the candidate baseline. Passing freezes only isolated-atom independent-particle C0. It does not license a width choice, a response fit, a molecular response claim, a continuum, an energy/force claim, or any experimental solvation panel.
